onset.Description: the onset of the target word within a stimulus (final word at the end of a sentence)

duration.Description: the duration of the target word within a stimulus (final word at the end of a sentence)

stim_onset_s_.Description: the trigger at the beginning of a stimulus (sentence)

stim_dur_s_.Description: the duration of the entire stimulus (sentence)

Levels.Picture-Sound: written text and audio presented together (introductions and prompts)
Levels.Sound: presented auditorially only (congruent and incongruent stimuli)

Levels.feedback: feedback on response to example stimulus (correct or incorrect)
Levels.break: prompt to ask if participant wanted a break
Levels.prompt: prompt to ask participant to respond
Levels.left: participant pressed left in response to stimulus
Levels.right: participant pressed right in response to stimulus
